verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no audit log or change-history feature showing which user changed what and when across the ledger. The only related item is that editing a manual journal entry creates a voiding (reversing) entry plus a new entry. That is an adjacent accounting behavior that keeps the prior entry, not a documented audit trail of user, timestamp and change.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see a complete audit trail of who changed what and when across the entire ledger
